description: Anime substyle registry — separate axis from implication packs and from style_mode.
note: Use with style_mode=anime_substyle. Do not fold into implication packs.

90s_cel.label: 90s Cel
90s_cel.prompt_language: 1990s anime cel animation, hand-inked outlines, flat cel shading, limited color palette, film grain, classic TV anime look

modern_digital_glam.label: Modern Digital Glam
modern_digital_glam.prompt_language: contemporary digital anime illustration, glossy skin, oversized irises, graphic makeup, soft painterly to cel hybrid, saturated fashion-anime lighting

gekiga_ink.label: Gekiga / Ink
gekiga_ink.prompt_language: gekiga dramatic ink, heavy blacks, adult manga linework, high contrast, sparse screentone, serious cinematic framing

mecha_line.label: Mecha Line
mecha_line.prompt_language: mecha anime mechanical line precision, hard surface panels, technical detail, cool industrial color, sharp edge control

moe_soft.label: Moe Soft
moe_soft.prompt_language: soft moe anime, round features, pastel lighting, gentle blush, delicate line, light screentone

dark_biomechanical.label: Dark Biomechanical
dark_biomechanical.prompt_language: dark biomechanical anime illustration, teal cyan volumetric light, industrial chains, glossy armor panels, detailed ink-to-paint hybrid
